Standalone checker replays arithmetic and counts; no infinite theorem is inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: A complete reduced Weierstrass-support zeta function and precise field of definition at q=11, the first member of the maximal-curve family with nonrational Weierstrass points. The datum is intrinsic, motivated by availability of exceptional marked points over finite extensions and not an arbitrary parameter slice. The published cardinality does not already fix Frobenius cycles, while the exact cubic distinction is potentially useful for pointed-curve arithmetic. Scientific scope is a natural finite classification, not a universal all-q contribution.
